thread:
customer-jen: Hey team — running into a weird 403 when I try to open our org settings (we're the account owner). Worked yesterday, now hitting "Permission denied". Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/snap123.png

maya (Support): Hi Jen — thanks for the report. Can you confirm the org id and whether you recently changed roles or SSO group mappings? Also, does the error happen for other owners in your org?

customer-jen: Org ID is org_7Qp9X. I didn't change my role. We did run a migration script last night to consolidate groups from our IdP. Other owners (2 people) also see the same 403. Browser console shows a 403 from /console/api/v1/orgs/org_7Qp9X/projects with body: 
```
{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "message": "caller lacks permission: projects.list for org org_7Qp9X"
}
```

maya (Support): Ok good repro, thanks. I'm going to escalate to eng and SRE. @ashish can you take a look?

ashish (Eng): I can check request routing and RBAC metadata. Can you paste an example curl with your API key redacted so I can replicate the exact call shape? Also interested if this is console-only or API too.

customer-jen: Here's a sanitized curl that gets the 403: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/orgs/org_7Qp9X/projects"
```
Response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "access_denied", "message": "User not authorized for org: org_7Qp9X" }
```

ashish (Eng): Thanks. I pulled logs for the API call and can see the authz check failing in the policy layer. Two hypotheses: 1) SSO group->role sync dropped the owner mapping, or 2) a role inheritance flag was flipped during the migration so project-level overrides are blocking org-level owner permissions. I'm going to query the RBAC store.

deploy-bot: [deploy] RBAC migration job finished 03:12 UTC (job id rbac-mig-2026-03-12-84)

arjun (SRE): Pulling audit logs now. If the migration tool toggled role_inheritance=false on org rows, org owners wouldn't get implicit project permissions. Running a quick DB query to check: 
```
SELECT id, role_inheritance, roles_json FROM orgs WHERE id = 'org_7Qp9X';
```
Result snippet: 
```
| id         | role_inheritance | roles_json                   |
| org_7Qp9X  | false            | {"members": [{"id":"u_42","role":"owner"}], "projects": []} |
```

arjun (SRE): That role_inheritance=false is suspicious — meant to be true for customer orgs. Looks like the migration set it false when it collapsed some group mappings. That would explain why the org owner doesn't get project-level list permissions.

luis (CS): Jen — sorry about the disruption. We're prioritizing. Quick question: do you need immediate console/project access now or can we apply a hotfix?

customer-jen: Need access to unblock a deploy in 30 minutes. Any temporary workaround?

ashish (Eng): Temporary workarounds: 1) Add the user as a direct project-level admin on affected projects, or 2) flip role_inheritance back to true for your org. The latter is a data change so we need an authorized patch. I can run a scoped fix for org_7Qp9X if an owner (Jen) confirms.

maya (Support): Jen — can you confirm you approve the quick fix (flip role_inheritance = true) for org_7Qp9X? We'll record and run it with SRE.

customer-jen: Confirmed, please proceed.

arjun (SRE): Performing action — creating migration rollback job with audit tag and running in dry-run first. Command: 
```
-- dry-run check (no change)
UPDATE orgs SET role_inheritance = true WHERE id = 'org_7Qp9X' AND role_inheritance = false;
```
Dry-run shows 1 row would be changed. Proceeding to apply now with audit_note = "support ticket #3456: customer approval to restore inheritance"

arjun (SRE): Applied. Affected rows: 1. Kicking internal cache invalidation for org_7Qp9X...

deploy-bot: [cache-invalidate] org-cache org_7Qp9X invalidated (request id: ci-9876)

ashish (Eng): Can you retry Jen?

customer-jen: Trying now... works!! I can see projects list and access settings. Thanks!! :raised_hands:

maya (Support): Awesome — leaving this thread open for 24h to monitor. Action items: 
- eng: add a migration guard to prevent role_inheritance toggles for orgs without explicit consent (ashish)
- sre: add a post-migration audit that fails if owner permissions drop (arjun)
- cs: notify impacted customers and include mitigation steps (luis)

ashish (Eng): I already opened issue 
https://redwood.internal/issue/INFR-2147 with a PR draft that adds a check: if migrating groups, do not set role_inheritance=false unless org_has_flag_migration_ok = true. Also adding a unit test.

arjun (SRE): I'll add an automated smoke test that runs permission checks for a sample owner after any RBAC migration.

customer-jen: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Could you also share the exact time and audit entry so I can confirm with my security team?

arjun (SRE): Audit entry: {"action":"update","target":"orgs:org_7Qp9X","actor":"arjun (SRE)","time":"2026-03-12T03:48:12Z","change":"role_inheritance:false->true","note":"support ticket #3456"}

maya (Support): Closing loop: Resolution = role_inheritance flag incorrectly flipped by RBAC migration; rolled back to true. Follow-ups assigned. Marking for 24h monitoring and then will file a postmortem if any other customers impacted.

customer-jen: Thanks everyone.

maya (Support): Thanks — will update ticket and send CS note. :white_check_mark:
